crossRefs.note: So Joshua struck all the land, the hill country, the South, the lowland, the slopes, and all their kings. He left no…
to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite in the hill…
These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad…
in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South…
Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.
The word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and encamped beside…
The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;
